import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32

RECIPE = {"lr": 0.001, "n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 8, "ppo_epochs": 2, "ent_coef": 0.005, "gamma": 0.97, "gae_lambda": 0.95, "clip_eps": 0.2}


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

W = 24
P = 16
GL = 64
NIN = 16

RECIPE = {"lr": 0.001, "n_envs": 256, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 32, "ppo_epochs": 1, "ent_coef": 0.01, "gamma": 0.97, "gae_lambda": 0.95, "clip_eps": 0.2}


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.Z = int(spec.Z)
        self.Y = int(spec.Y)
        self.X = int(spec.X)
        self.T = int(spec.n_types)
        self.stem = nn.Conv2d(NIN, W, 1)
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(W, W, 3, padding=1)
        self.col = nn.Conv2d(2 * W, W, 1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(W, W, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(W, spec.footprints, P, P)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * W, GL), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(GL, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(GL, 1)
        nn.init.orthogonal_(self.done_head.weight, gain=0.01)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.done_head.bias)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B = obs.shape[0]
        Z, Y, X, T = self.Z, self.Y, self.X, self.T
        L = torch.stack([obs[:, 0:Z], obs[:, Z:2 * Z], obs[:, 2 * Z:3 * Z], obs[:, 3 * Z:4 * Z]], dim=2)
        ones = torch.ones(B, 1, 2, Y, X, device=obs.device, dtype=obs.dtype)
        zeros2 = torch.zeros(B, 1, 2, Y, X, device=obs.device, dtype=obs.dtype)
        zeros4 = torch.zeros(B, 1, 4, Y, X, device=obs.device, dtype=obs.dtype)
        ground = torch.cat([ones, zeros2], dim=2)
        below = torch.cat([ground, L[:, :Z - 1]], dim=1)
        above = torch.cat([L[:, 1:], zeros4], dim=1)
        g3 = obs[:, 4 * Z:4 * Z + 3].unsqueeze(1).expand(B, Z, 3, Y, X)
        zc = torch.linspace(0.0, 1.0, Z, device=obs.device, dtype=obs.dtype).view(1, Z, 1, 1, 1).expand(B, Z, 1, Y, X)
        x = torch.cat([below, L, above, g3, zc], dim=2).reshape(B * Z, NIN, Y, X)
        h = F.relu(self.stem(x))
        h = F.relu(h + self.c1(h))
        h5 = h.reshape(B, Z, W, Y, X)
        colf = torch.cat([h5.mean(1), h5.amax(1)], dim=1)
        c = self.col(colf)
        h = F.relu(h5 + c.unsqueeze(1)).reshape(B * Z, W, Y, X)
        f = F.relu(h + self.c2(h))
        s = self.head(f).reshape(B, Z, T, Y, X)
        place = torch.logsumexp(s, dim=1).flatten(1)
        f5 = f.reshape(B, Z, W, Y, X)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f5.mean((1, 3, 4)), f5.amax((1, 3, 4))], dim=1))
        d = self.done_head(g)
        lp_place = F.log_softmax(place, dim=1) + F.logsigmoid(-d)
        lp_done = F.logsigmoid(d)
        logits = torch.cat([lp_place, lp_done], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

analyses.1: There are no trials yet. The starting network scored 0.000 dev success on both seeds, so I can't yet tell whether the bottleneck is learning or generalisation. The default recipe allows only about 32 PPO updates of 4,096 steps, each reused for 4 epochs. With gamma 0.95, the +1 exact-build bonus is heavily discounted over 10–30-step episodes. The starting network also never feeds global context back into the per-cell placement logits, and it doesn't see the legality mask. Following the suggested first round, I split the trials to attribute effects: (a) recipe only: 2 epochs, more and smaller updates, a longer horizon and lower entropy; (b) architecture only: a mask input, global context broadcast to cells, a third residual convolution and small-gain output initialisation, costing about 1.3× the starting FLOPs; (c) both together. Until dev success rises above 0, I'll rank by training success.
analyses.2: All three round-1 trials scored 0 on dev and 0 on training success, so the problem is learning, not generalisation. More samples (231k steps) and the context architecture both changed nothing. My main suspect is the DONE action. It is one logit among about 257 actions, so it is sampled about 1/200 of the time. Early DONE loses the shaped reward, so PPO pushes it down further. The +1 exact-build bonus needs DONE to be chosen in the one state where the build is complete, so it may almost never be seen. Round 2 tests a factorised action head: a sigmoid gate decides DONE versus place, then a softmax picks the placement. The test is run under r1c1's recipe (one change) and under a 1-epoch maximum-sample recipe. A third candidate adds a layer-equivariant per-layer convolution: features are shared across height layers, with stacked neighbouring layers and logsumexp over layers for the landing choice. Training runs took only 55–74 s, so there is plenty of time headroom.
analyses.3: All 6 trials (12 seeds) score 0 on dev and about 0 on training success. They varied PPO epochs (1, 2, 4), sample count (94k–406k), gamma/lambda, DONE gating, mask and context inputs, and a per-layer shared-conv design. None of these moved training success, so the problem is learning itself. Neither more samples nor DONE exploration fixed it alone. The time limit is not a factor: the slowest trial took 145 s, far under 900 s. Two causes remain plausible. (1) The pool head cannot easily look up whether the cells at a brick's landing layer are wanted, because the landing layer is the maximum height under the footprint. Max/min/avg pooling of a linear projection does not express "missing at layer max-height". (2) Entropy 0.005–0.01 keeps the sampled policy too noisy to finish exact builds, so the +1 bonus is rarely seen. This round tests both as a 2x2 design, using r2c2 (gated DONE, 1 epoch) as the base. Results that contradict the description: none yet, apart from the uniform zeros.
analyses.4: After 9 trials every result is 0: dev success, and training success over the last 10% of training. Changing the recipe (1, 2 or 4 epochs; gamma 0.95 or 0.97; entropy 0.002 to 0.01), the factorised DONE gate, global context, a per-layer shared convolution and the landing-gated head all left training success at 0. When nothing learns at all, the cause is more likely a structural mismatch than tuning. Every head so far is translation-equivariant and assumes the described anchor convention (top-left corner, y-major index). If this world indexes actions differently (transposed axes, a different anchor, an offset), a per-cell convolutional head cannot learn the mapping. For this last round I test heads that do not assume the action layout: flat linear logits added to the convolutional head, a pure flat MLP head with the mask as input, and the hybrid head with a recipe that collects whole episodes per rollout.
